title: Plow
description: The first time this creature's HP reaches [blue]150[/blue] or below, it becomes [gold]Stunned[/gold].
smart_description: The first time this creature's HP reaches [blue]150[/blue] or below, it becomes [gold]Stunned[/gold] and loses all its [gold]Strength[/gold].
notes: This is a triggered debuff applied to enemies. When the specified HP threshold is crossed via damage, it triggers once: stuns the creature, removes all Strength and Temporary Strength powers, then removes itself from play. After triggering, it has no further effect.
